decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink lies outside the firm's engineering core and was only mentioned on the website, so it is a candidate for problemistic search, but its low carrying cost and the firm's reinvested revenues let it stay for now while its results remain uncertain.
The modular plant extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy offer and need few extra resources, so the firm can carry them while it learns how they perform against its aspirations.

As a flagship with its own website page that is central to the firm's direction, the waste-oil-to-energy plant has strong management commitment, so a single early year below aspiration would not lead to dropping it.
The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is a strategic flagship that fits the firm's long-term venture strategy, so the firm would tolerate uncertain early results instead of releasing its resources.
